name: Rellan Strake
source_profile:
Captain Rellan Strake: “The Ferryman” (LE) 
Rellan Strake was once a decorated captain in the naval forces 
of Ballantyre, responsible for commanding a flotilla of 
shallow-draft vessels used to transport troops and provisions 
along Cador's inland waterways. When the northern rebellion 
collapsed, Strake escaped east with several boats and the 
remnants of his company. 
Strake maintains an almost comically professional attitude 
toward his criminal enterprise. His men still observe naval 
ranks, maintain immaculate equipment, and issue written 
receipts for certain transactions. He has even been known to return stolen cargo when an 
employer produces sufficient documentation proving its ownership. 
Reputation: Merchants generally regard Strake as a dangerous but reliable businessman. His 
company has a reputation for honoring contracts, provided the agreed payment arrives. 
Adventure hook: A wealthy Westbridge merchant hires the party to escort a shipment 
downriver. Halfway through the journey, they discover that the merchant has already hired 
Strake to seize the same cargo for an elaborate insurance fraud.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 36–36 (source excerpt)
